title: Limit CPUs or threads via environmental variable
author: davidhemp
body_preview: It would be helpful to be able to set an environmental variable to limit the number of CPUs parallel searches will use. On a multi-user system it is common for ripgrep to use many CPUs and prevent other users from running commands. I know there is the "-j" flag but this is easy to forget so if we could set a default in a users environment it would be very useful.

title: Dependency bincode is unmaintained and flagged by RUSTSEC-2025-0141
author: taladar
body_preview: The dependency bincode 1.3.3 used in bat is unmaintained  https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2025-0141  which means any projects using bat will get a security alert if they use tools like cargo audit or cargo deny check advisories.
